svg.title: MarkeTech frontend: the path of a request
svg.desc: Panel A: in development, npm run dev:link starts Vite, which serves the source files and proxies /api and /_allauth to the Django runserver; in production the Docker image builds dist and Nginx serves it, answering index.html for every application address and passing /api, /_allauth, /admin and /static to the backend container. Panel B: the browser loads index.html, then main.ts creates the Vue application with the i18n and router plugins and mounts App.vue, whose RouterView displays the page matching the address, such as HomePage.vue and its components. Panel C: components reach the backend only through api/http.ts, whose fetch goes through the Vite proxy or Nginx to Django. Panel D: moving between pages does not ask the server again.
svg.text: MarkeTech frontend: the path of a request
From the address typed by the user to the page on screen, and from the page to the backend. Follow the numbers 1 to 12.
Real files of the repository at the router step of the account slice (16.10.2026).
Two servers for the same files
Vite on the workstation · Nginx in Docker, on your PC or on the VPS
Start it once, leave it running.

svg.text: VPS only; absent on your PC
Same rule for both servers, so the code in the browser (panels B and C) never knows which one answers
A file that exists is sent as is. Any other address gets index.html: the application chooses the page.
/api and /_allauth are not files: they are passed to the backend. Each new prefix is added on both sides.
in the browser, each time an address is opened or refreshed
